title: Re-pitched clips and speed flips keep their pitch and timing
description:
As a producer, I want re-pitched clips and speed flips to keep their pitch and timing in the set, so that turntable-style moves and half-time grooves survive.

```gherkin
Feature: Re-pitch and speed
  Scenario: A re-pitched clip plays at its speed, pitch and all
    Given the clip "voice" is warped with "repitch" at a speed of 1.25
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "voice" is warped in "Re-Pitch" mode
    And each plays its audio 1.25 times as fast as recorded

  Scenario: A sample with no beat grid can still be re-pitched
    Given the sample "speech.wav" has no beats in its manifest
    And the clip "voice" is warped with "repitch"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And every clip of "voice" has warp markers only at its start and end

  Scenario Outline: Speed flips
    Given the track "brk" is flipped with "<flip>"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "brk" plays its audio at <rate> times its warped speed
    Examples:
      | flip       | rate |
      | half       | 0.5  |
      | double     | 2    |
      | speed 0.75 | 0.75 |

  Scenario: Gate and stutter make short clips
    Given the track "brk" is flipped with "gate 50%" and "stutter 4"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the clips of "brk" start and end where the compiled notes do
```
